text: Doctor A, God, I don't know why they keep changing the codes to the elevators! I just barely got used to the last one! They sent us the new one today. I was going to pin it up in our office, but, in all of the, err, ... chaos... I think I must've dropped it somewhere near the cages... (You know, the room with the kennels. In case all that slacking off finally caught up to you...) When you get here, could you grab it for me and send me a photo so I don't forget it again? Can't be around all these mutts without a quick way out, you know...
